args.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Draw a TWO PANEL pencil construction storyboard, wide canvas, no lettering. Original photos 1-4 are sole dog likeness authorities. Image5 is provisional model proportions only, NOT coat texture. Panel LEFT veterinary lobby: Buddy charcoal moderately elongated dog with cream beard, brows and lower legs stands on four substantial feet, body facing right toward cropped vet tech scrubs legs, head turned left toward Neet small tan smooth dog sitting behind with both front paws now DOWN. Buddy claims his blue chew toy verbally (NO toy present). Connected neck torso pelvis; clear floor supports. Heather has left; no other person visible except tech lower legs. Panel RIGHT dreamy exam room: Buddy reclining fully supported sternum down on padded exam table, one forepaw lazily lifted, other forepaw forward supported, hindquarters and bent hind legs unambiguous. Friendly yellow Labrador in nurse cap leans from floor beside table, separate scruffy terrier sits on floor at opposite side. Dream wavy room edges, no gold tooth yet, no utensils or gravy literally. Show Buddy spine ribcage pelvis and limb attachment with light construction lines. No shaggy body contours; smooth short torso coats. Three dogs exactly in right panel; two dogs exactly in left. Thin lines with modest value washes.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Retain image1 waiting-room composition exactly: Buddy seated bench beside closed cat carrier, Neet admiring seated enormous gray Dane, no other changes to anatomy poses expressions furnishings. Correct only fur finish on Neet and Buddy: render their short torso and leg coats as smooth restrained watercolor color washes, no engraved hatch marks, no curled strands or raised shag contours. Preserve Buddy furnished cream muzzle brows pendant ear fringes and distal paw hair; do not erase regional grooming. Image2 provides BODY FINISH ONLY for short smooth coats, not composition/characters/pose; do not copy park setting or necklaces. Images3-5 original photos sole anatomical authority. No sock visible, no gold tooth. Keep fine-legged Neet full narrow torso and tiny nub; all support contacts preserved. Warm storybook watercolor with clean smooth short-coat fills.

Use case: illustration-story. Finish ONLY LEFT panel of image1 drawn staging as one landscape warm watercolor illustration, no panels no lettering. Vet lobby. Buddy stands on four clearly separate substantial grounded legs, moderately elongated full charcoal torso and real clearance, body aimed toward cropped vet-tech scrubs legs at right but head looking BACK LEFT at Neet with mildly indignant possessive eyes, mouth nearly closed. Neet seated at back left with both fine front paws DOWN, chastened expression. This is after Buddy says his blue chew toy is still his: NO toy present. Heather has already left. Image2 BODY FINISH ONLY: smooth restrained watercolor fills on short torso coats, no engraved curls, hatch fur, shag contours; don't copy its scene or jewelry. Image3 Buddy frontal grooming, image4 Buddy torso continuity original anatomy authority; image5 Neet original identity authority. Preserve Buddy cream beard, light brows, pendant furnished ears, pale lower legs, close dark torso. Neet full narrow torso, broad triangular ears, short tan coat cream muzzle bib tiny nub. Different human provisional only lower legs. Fine polished outlines, warm cream and muted blue clinic, humor via dogs looking at each other. Exact four legs for standing Buddy; seated Neet visible front paws and folded hind paws. No premature gold tooth.

Use case: illustration-story. Finish ONLY RIGHT panel of image1 drawn staging as one landscape polished warm watercolor image. Dreamlike veterinary exam room: Buddy reclines sternum-down fully supported on padded table, one forepaw lazily lifted mid-wave, other forepaw supported on table, folded hind legs connected to pelvis, long continuous full charcoal torso. Modest head cream beard, light eyebrows, pendant furnished ears. Friendly yellow Labrador in nurse cap stands on floor left looking up toward him; scruffy terrier sits on floor right, laughing. Exactly three dogs, no Neet, no human, no gold tooth yet, no literal gravy or boat. Wavy watercolor room edges indicate anesthesia dream without depicting medical instructions. Image2 BODY FINISH ONLY: short smooth torso coats as clean color washes, no curled etched strands, no raised shaggy outlines on Buddy; retain long grooming ONLY beard eyebrows ears paw tips. Image3 and4 original photos sole anatomical authority for Buddy, image5 provisional model geometry NOT fur texture. Important Buddy smaller modest dog head, substantial limbs with visible attached joints, reclining pelvis and spine traceable, paws no duplicates. Cheerful dreamy sleepy expression. No text logos or speech bubbles.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 target: preserve the entire composition, poses, facial expressions, body proportions, all paws, people legs, room. REQUIRED MATERIAL CORRECTION: completely REMOVE all drawn fur strands from BOTH dogs' torso, neck, chest and upper legs. Fill short-coat body regions with smooth simple flat watercolor color areas and broad gentle shadows, like image2 BODY FINISH ONLY. Zero etched strokes, curls, crosshatching, raised shag contours or furry ridges on either torso. Buddy charcoal back must be visually SMOOTH with continuous CLEAN unbroken silhouette. Preserve furnished hair ONLY on Buddy moustache/beard, eyebrows, ears and tiny tips of paws; preserve cream chest color patches but as SMOOTH color. Neet entire tan coat and cream bib should be SMOOTH. Buddy head turns slightly farther left toward Neet but keep connected neck. Images3-5 originals identity authority. Do not change anatomy or add objects. No toy present, no gold tooth. Storybook paint, not realistic individual fur rendering.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 target preserve whole dreamy exam-room composition exactly including three separate dogs, Buddy supported reclining on table with one raised forepaw. MATERIAL CORRECTION on Buddy ONLY (center charcoal dog): replace ALL torso/neck/upper leg rendered fur texture with SMOOTH flat color washes and broad simple shadows like image2 BODY FINISH ONLY. No carved lines, curls, hatching, raised shaggy silhouette. Keep modest head, pale beard eyebrow ear furnishings, paw tip furnishings. Torso charcoal smooth, cream chest patches smooth. Side flank and shoulder completely clean. Image3-4 originals sole likeness authority. Keep friendly provisional Labrador nurse and scruffy terrier. No gold tooth, no new objects, no text. Do not alter connected body construction or table support. No need to change secondary terrier shag.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 target keep all content poses expressions anatomy and setting exactly. FINAL SHORT-COAT CORRECTION: make Neet tan torso neck chest and legs COMPLETELY SMOOTH simple color washes with broad shadows, no wispy contour, no etched curls or strand patterns anywhere. Also Buddy bench seated charcoal torso/chest/upper legs completely smooth fill. Image2 short-body coat FINISH ONLY reference for required smooth surface; retain image1 figures and pose. Keep Buddy beard brow ear furnishings distinct and pale distal paw hair; cream patches on chest are color not tufts. Great Dane and cat unchanged. No sock or gold tooth. Preserve original's fine legs, full torso and tiny nub. No new objects or cropping.
